name: Clairvoyance
overview: Scripture clearly forbids engaging in practices related to clairvoyance and seeking knowledge through familiar spirits or wizards, as seen in Leviticus 19:26 and 19:31 where God commands His people not to use enchantments or consult those with familiar spirits. The severity of this prohibition is underscored in Leviticus 20:27, which prescribes death for those who practice such occult arts. Deuteronomy 18:9-10 further warns against adopting the abominable customs of surrounding nations, explicitly forbidding divination, observing times, and witchcraft. Even in 1 Samuel 28:13, where King Saul encounters a woman claiming to see spirits, the narrative illustrates the danger and deception involved in seeking supernatural insight apart from God.
